name: Elie Saab
shortDescription: Honey-gold facets, daylight amber, and couture clarity.
description: A luminous amber floral built around orange blossom and patchouli, wrapped in radiant woods. Faceted glass catches the light like evening couture — confident, polished, unforgettable.

name: Replica
shortDescription: Sun-drenched notes, soft fruit, and linen-warm memory.
description: Inspired by Provence at golden hour — ripe grapes, soft rose, and sun on linen. A memory-in-a-bottle composition for slow mornings and long evenings.

name: Aerin
shortDescription: Amber musk, polished stone cap, and quiet glamour.
description: Creamy musk and warm amber rest on a veil of rose and coconut. Polished and serene — the scent of quiet luxury and soft light.

name: Elie Saab
shortDescription: Radiant florals with a couture amber trail.
description: The same couture spirit in a fresh facet — luminous white florals meet honeyed amber for a signature that feels both airy and anchored.

name: Replica
shortDescription: Soft fruit, airy musk, and nostalgic warmth.
description: A softer chapter in the Replica line — gentle fruit, clean musk, and the feeling of sunlight through curtains.

name: Aerin
shortDescription: Velvet musk and rose in golden light.
description: Deeper rose and musk with a satin dry-down — evening-ready, still effortlessly Aerin.
